title: Prompt Engineer
description: Master systematic context engineering, few-shot conditioning, chain-of-thought methodologies, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails for frontier AI models.

goal.objective: Optimize natural language interfaces with frontier LLMs, engineering robust prompting strategies, programmatic evaluations, and safety alignments.

learn.summary: Master Chain-of-Thought, ReAct frameworks, few-shot prompting, DSPy programmatic prompt compilation, evaluation with DeepEval, and prompt injection defenses.

capstone_projects.title: Automated Prompt Evaluation & Red-Teaming Suite
capstone_projects.description: Build an automated regression test bench for LLM applications that evaluates accuracy, hallucination rates, and security vulnerability.

capstone_projects.title: Reliable Structured Output Extraction Pipeline with DSPy
capstone_projects.description: Build an automated prompt optimization pipeline that transforms unstructured contracts into validated Pydantic models using few-shot bootstrapping and assertion checks.

interview_focus: Prompt Injection Attack Vectors (Direct vs Indirect)
Techniques for Enforcing Strict Deterministic JSON Output

tree.name: Foundational Concepts & Principles of Prompt Engineering
tree.description: Master the core mechanisms of Large Language Models, understand how they process information, and apply fundamental principles for designing effective prompts that elicit desired responses.

children.name: Core LLM Concepts & Architectures
children.description: Gain a foundational understanding of LLM architecture (e.g., Transformer, Decoder-only), tokenization, the attention mechanism, embedding spaces, and the difference between pre-training, fine-tuning, and in-context learning to grasp model capabilities and limitations.

resources.title: Master Prompt Engineering: Full Course (Jeff Su)
AI Prompt Engineering Deep Dive (IBM Technology)

children.name: Prompt Structure and Key Elements
children.description: Learn to construct effective prompts using clear instructions, providing relevant context, defining roles/personas, using few-shot examples effectively, and employing delimiters for clarity and structured input. Understand the impact of prompt length and order.

resources.title: Chain of Thought Prompting Explained (Matt Wolfe)

children.name: Principles of Effective Prompt Design
children.description: Understand best practices for writing clear, concise, specific, and unambiguous prompts. Learn iterative refinement techniques to optimize prompt performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency, focusing on aligning model output with user intent and business objectives.

resources.title: Best practices for prompt engineering with OpenAI API
Few-Shot Prompting and In-Context Learning (Yannic Kilcher)

children.name: LLM Limitations & Common Failure Modes
children.description: Identify common challenges such as hallucinations, stale knowledge, prompt injection vulnerabilities, context window limitations, inherent biases, and overconfident responses. Learn strategies to anticipate, detect, and mitigate these issues effectively through prompt design.

tree.name: Advanced Prompt Design Patterns & Structured Outputs
tree.description: Explore advanced prompting strategies and design patterns for complex tasks, generating highly structured data, enhancing LLM reasoning capabilities, and integrating external knowledge for robust application development.

resources.title: Master Prompt Engineering: Full Course (Jeff Su)
AI Prompt Engineering Deep Dive (IBM Technology)

children.name: Advanced Reasoning Techniques (CoT, ToT, Self-Consistency)
children.description: Master advanced reasoning techniques like Chain-of-Thought (CoT), Tree-of-Thought (ToT), Self-consistency, and Generated Knowledge Prompting. Learn to guide LLMs through complex multi-step reasoning tasks, enabling self-correction, planning, and improved logical coherence.

resources.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
Self-consistency improves chain of thought reasoning
Chain of Thought Prompting Explained (Matt Wolfe)

children.name: Generating Structured Outputs (JSON, XML, Pydantic)
children.description: Learn to precisely control LLM output formats, including JSON, XML, Markdown, and custom schemas. Implement schema enforcement, leverage Pydantic models for robust validation, and develop strategies for handling uncertain or missing information while ensuring valid, parseable, and usable structured data.

resources.title: Few-Shot Prompting and In-Context Learning (Yannic Kilcher)

children.name: Tool Use, Function Calling, and Agents
children.description: Integrate LLMs with external tools and APIs through function calling. Understand agentic workflows, multi-step planning, memory, and frameworks like ReAct, LangChain, or LlamaIndex to enable LLMs to interact with the real world, retrieve information, and perform complex actions autonomously.

children.name: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
children.description: Understand the RAG paradigm for grounding LLMs in up-to-date and specific knowledge. Learn about advanced chunking strategies, embedding models, vector databases, and effectively integrating retrieved context into prompts to reduce hallucinations and improve factual accuracy and relevance. Explore re-ranking and query transformation.

resources.title: Master Prompt Engineering: Full Course (Jeff Su)
AI Prompt Engineering Deep Dive (IBM Technology)

tree.name: Robustness: Evaluation, Testing & LLM Safety
tree.description: Develop robust methodologies for systematically evaluating prompt performance, ensuring reliability, detecting biases, and implementing comprehensive safety and guardrail mechanisms for LLM applications in production.

resources.title: DeepLearning.AI - Evaluating and Debugging Generative AI Models
Chain of Thought Prompting Explained (Matt Wolfe)

children.name: Prompt Evaluation Methodologies & Metrics
children.description: Explore different evaluation approaches, including human-in-the-loop, LLM-assisted evaluation, and programmatic checks. Define and measure quantitative metrics (e.g., accuracy, relevance, completeness, conciseness) and qualitative rubrics for assessing prompt output quality and identifying areas for improvement using tools like LangSmith or DeepEval.

resources.title: Few-Shot Prompting and In-Context Learning (Yannic Kilcher)

children.name: Developing Comprehensive Test Sets & Benchmarking
children.description: Learn to create diverse and comprehensive test sets, including 'golden' examples, edge cases, and adversarial prompts to test robustness. Establish baselines and perform systematic benchmarking to compare prompt versions, model variations, or different LLMs against predefined performance criteria.

resources.title: Best Practices for Building LLM Benchmarks
Adversarial Prompting: What it is and How to Mitigate it

children.name: LLM Safety, Bias Mitigation & Guardrails
children.description: Implement robust safety measures to prevent prompt injection, data leakage, adversarial attacks, and content generation of harmful outputs. Understand strategies for detecting and mitigating biases, implementing content moderation, and utilizing guardrail frameworks like Guardrails AI or NeMo Guardrails for responsible AI development and deployment.

resources.title: Master Prompt Engineering: Full Course (Jeff Su)
AI Prompt Engineering Deep Dive (IBM Technology)

children.name: Practice: Iterative Prompt Refinement & A/B Testing
children.description: Gain hands-on experience in iteratively refining prompts based on evaluation feedback and real-world performance data. Learn to set up, execute, and analyze A/B tests for different prompt versions or strategies to identify optimal performance, user engagement, and achieve desired outcomes in production environments.

resources.title: Chain of Thought Prompting Explained (Matt Wolfe)

tree.name: PromptOps: Deployment, Monitoring & Management
tree.description: Master the operational aspects of prompt engineering, including version control, deployment strategies, continuous monitoring, and effective project management for LLM applications in production environments.

resources.title: Best practices for building LLM applications
Few-Shot Prompting and In-Context Learning (Yannic Kilcher)

children.name: Prompt Versioning, Management, and Registries
children.description: Learn best practices for version controlling prompts, managing prompt libraries, and utilizing prompt registries or hubs. Understand prompt templating engines, configuration management, and environment-specific prompt variations for dynamic, scalable, and maintainable prompt generation and deployment.

children.name: LLM Application Monitoring & Observability
children.description: Implement robust monitoring for LLM applications, tracking key metrics like latency, cost, token usage, error rates, user satisfaction, and output quality. Establish feedback loops, implement data/concept drift detection, and set up alerting for continuous model and prompt improvement in production using platforms like LangSmith or Weights & Biases.

resources.title: Monitoring LLMs: Why it's critical and how to do it right
Master Prompt Engineering: Full Course (Jeff Su)
AI Prompt Engineering Deep Dive (IBM Technology)

children.name: CI/CD for LLM Applications
children.description: Integrate prompt and LLM application testing into Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. Automate deployment, testing, performance validation, and rollback strategies to ensure reliable and efficient updates for LLM-powered systems, treating prompts as code.

resources.title: Operationalizing LLMs: MLOps and Prompt Engineering
Chain of Thought Prompting Explained (Matt Wolfe)

children.name: Building a Prompt Engineering Portfolio & Case Studies
children.description: Document and showcase prompt engineering projects, demonstrating measurable improvements in performance, safety, efficiency, and user experience. Develop compelling case studies that highlight problem-solving skills, technical choices, and the tangible business impact of prompt engineering solutions, suitable for a professional portfolio.

resources.title: How to Build an AI/ML Portfolio
Few-Shot Prompting and In-Context Learning (Yannic Kilcher)
